name: manual_b07e17
claim: LM Studio reasoning models (Windows 27B) need max_tokens >= 4096 and commandTimeout >= 300s. They return reasoning_content not text; agent parsers must check reasoning_content as fallback.

decisions.notes: Mined from PT lessons Apr 29 (Mac 9B stall fix) + Jun 22 (LM Studio 27B canary): lower max_tokens triggers finish_reason=length with empty visible content. commandTimeout 300s required.
